propositions: When a plan asserts that a named module provides a specific capability, the plan-review gate must verify the assertion against actual code to detect cases where the capability is absent (dc58: signing missing from completion.py; db7b: compaction does not handle REVIEW_RESULT).
When a plan asserts that a capability must be built or is absent, the gate must detect when that capability already exists in the codebase (5886: fetcher.py already emits unmapped-Jira-status alert).

The new advisory criterion `asserted-capability` must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, and AGENT_TIER sets with routing entry, rubric prompt, and guide section; registration invariants validated by registry.validate_packaged_routing() and registry.validate_criteria_guide().

The criterion integrates into the existing four-pass finder/verifier/decide/coach machinery using agentic dispatch for code-grounding, ships with advisory posture (never blocks), and auto-flows into criterion_effectiveness.py standing recorder with zero per-criterion wiring.

A bounded sanity check with 3 E1-verified miss cases (dc58, db7b, 5886) reconstructed as must-fire and 3 clean controls must show >=2/3 recall on misses and advisory-only posture on clean false-fires, recorded in asserted_capability_sanity.json with promotion-gate dogfood signal.
